prompts: Landscape 16:9 main menu poster: Liu Bei with giant ears and dual straw sandals center, Guan Yu with red face long black beard green headcloth at left firing luminous green mung beans from hands, Zhang Fei with dark beard huge eyebrows purple robe at right waving a blossoming peach branch as magic wand. Three brothers fighting together in a hilarious battle pose, yellow turban silhouettes far background, peach grove and warm golden sunset. Characters occupy upper middle, darker uncluttered lower third for game menus. Polished bold cartoon anime flat cel shading, funny big heads and tiny bean feet, no text or logos.

Single full body Guan Yu hero, enormous red round face, long stylized black beard, green headcloth and tiny green robe with cream collar, narrow proud eyes, comically serious. Two short arms hold bright green mung beans as ranged weapons. Tiny bean feet no legs. Same simplified thick brown outline chibi game style as reference Liu Bei. Full figure with 8% margin, transparent, no text, no background.

Single full body Zhang Fei hero, enormous round tan face, thick black rounded beard, impossibly thick bushy eyebrows, wide laughing eyes, tiny purple robe red sash. Two short arms holding a small peach tree branch with pink blossom as magic wand. Tiny bean feet no legs. Same simplified thick brown outline chibi game style as reference Liu Bei. Full figure with 8% margin transparent, no text.

Single full body funny Yellow Turban spear thrower enemy. Giant round head tiny ochre body, yellow headband, squinting one eye to aim, firmly gripping a short throwing spear with metal point. Small bundle of spears on back. Tiny bean feet, cartoon thick brown outlines muted yellow flat cel shades. Full figure 10% margin transparent no text. Match big head chibi game style.

Single full body funny Yellow Turban cavalry enemy: oversized-head angry peasant rider in yellow headband perched on tiny chunky brown pony with short legs and wide terrified eyes, short spear in hand pointing forward. Clear horse+rider silhouette, 10% margin transparent no text, bold brown outline flat cartoon cel shading, readable 90px game sprite.

Single full body Yellow Turban chief boss. Enormous round head, huge angry eyebrows, curled little moustache, yellow headwrap with a ridiculously oversized knot, tiny stocky ochre armored torso with dark brown trim, holding a large wooden mallet firmly. Tiny bean feet. Funny threatening silhouette, polished thick brown outline flat cel cartoon, 10% margin transparent no text.

Game item icon sheet EXACT 4 columns x 3 rows, 12 equal cells, transparent background, no text or borders. Thick dark brown outline, warm flat cel shading, isolated icons centered in each cell, uniform scale and 15% cell padding. Reading left to right top to bottom: 1 woven straw insole; 2 green mung bean seed packet; 3 pink peach blossom charm; 4 red headband; 5 iron cooking pot helmet; 6 golden copper coin pouch; 7 bamboo book scroll; 8 red chili pepper; 9 white steamed bun; 10 little drum; 11 straw rain cape; 12 peach-shaped jade pendant. Cute Three Kingdoms comedy game equipment, strong simple shapes.
